# City Fun Time: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-11 · code 94100543a5de · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Your real neighbourhood, rebuilt in 3D from the map. Run errands, make friends, fall in love, open businesses and take over the blocks. 150+ missions at real places.
**Live:** https://city-fun-time.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/cityfuntime · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/cityfuntime/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py cityfuntime` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms version (merged to master; found 2026-11-11).** The 3D game engine stays JavaScript: `theme/assets/three.min.js`,
  `cft-tiles.js`, `cft-world.js`, `cft-content.js`, `cft-game.js`, `cft-fun.js`, `cft-ui.js` (the game's HUD, phone, dialogs and panels are
  drawn by cft-ui.js; its CSS is the `/* ===== play.html =====` block in app.css). They load on demand: their addresses are
  `<meta name="cft-asset">` tags in head_html (tools/assets.py keeps the `?v=` hashes current), read by cft-kit.js.
- **The glue** is `theme/assets/cft-kit.js` (window.CFT) + `client_code/cft.py`. Server calls from the engine go
  `CFT.api` -> `window.CFT_HOST.call` (Python, cft.py `_host_call`, JSON text in/out; `{ok: False}` replies become errors).
  `state.set_me` tells the engine who is signed in (`CFT.me`), so saves stay per person.
- **Saves**: localStorage `cityfuntime.save.<user id|guest>` (same key as the old JS app, so saves survived the conversion)
  + the server (`put_save` every 20 s, on exit and when the tab hides). A guest game is offered on Life after signing up
  (`CFT.adopt`) and kept by pressing Play. Photos: `cityfuntime.photos.<id>` in the browser only.
- **Life / Quests / Album** call `cft.prepare()` (content scripts + the save) and then `cft.view(name)`: cft-kit.js
  VIEWS turns the save into plain JSON for Labels and RepeatingPanels; Python never walks engine objects.
  New field on a page = add it to that VIEWS function, then show it in the Form.
- **#play** has no layout (full screen): Pages/Play holds Components/Game, which mounts on show and destroys on hide.
- Mission cards carry `host` (the Quests page) and call `host.open_mission(id)`; Dialogs/Mission closes with
  "track" / "play" / None (the Play button closes the dialog before navigating).
- App Server 1.18 pads Label text 7px: app.css sets `.ui .anvil-label > .anvil-label-text { padding: 0 }`.
- Design notes left on purpose (the "Sticker City" identity): cream paper, hard offset shadows, emoji icons, the
  game HUD's own colour literals.
- ArkMusic is `theme/assets/ark-music.js` (was web/pages/_arkmusic.html): APP_MAKER/tools/music_sync.py must point there.
- Tests: `python tools/check.py`; `python -I tools/ui_test.py` = tools/ui/smoke.js at desktop + phone width
  (a11y.js / design.js with `--only`). The 3D game is played by `python -I tools/live/game_test.py` (a plain page served by
  tools/live/harness.py, real map tiles, software WebGL): gametest.js = missions, funtest.js = street life; `--shots DIR` = pictures.
- **The wacky update (2026-11-11).** Street life is `cft-fun.js` (G.fun: monsters, weapons, strangers and sweethearts, street
  folk and the crown, pranks and chasers, banana peels, trampolines, street events); its data is the last third of
  cft-content.js; its state is `save.fun` + counters. cft-game.js calls it at marked places (tick, findInteraction, newDay,
  speedMul, happyTarget, G.buy, G.attack). The city side is in cft-world.js: sky, street furniture and parked cars (`layProps`),
  traffic lights (`nodeAt` / `trySignal` / `sigState` / `buildSignal`), made-up shops (`W.makeShop` in `registerSub`), signs
  (`updateSigns` / `buildSign`), `W.monster`, `W.propMesh`, `W.burst` / `W.pop`. Pranks, bans and rivals only ever touch
  made-up shops (`place.virtual`), never real places from the map. Chasers run at 86% of the player's walking speed.
- **People models (2026-11-11).** `W.person(look, npc)` in cft-world.js: rounded figures with faces, nine hair styles and
  jointed limbs (userData: body, head, legL/R + kneeL/R, armL/R + elbowL/R, handL/R). Positive rotation.x = limb forward;
  knees bend negative, elbows positive. `W.animate` owns every joint. The player's look = `playerLook()` (cft-game.js) from
  `save.look` + worn gear; `U.lookEditor()` (cft-ui.js) changes it in the game.
- **The long game (2026-11-11).** `cft-rpg.js` (G.rpg): loot in rarity colours, talents, reputation (from counters), achievements,
  titles, rested XP, discovery XP + chests, rare monsters, mission reward picks. Data `D.RPG`, state `save.rpg`. One bonus
  aggregator `G.rpg.bonus(key)` read at marked places in cft-game.js / cft-fun.js. UI: phone apps hero / rep / ach in cft-ui.js;
  the ⭐ level chip opens Character and shows unspent points + rewards to pick.
- three r149: tinted InstancedMeshes need their own material (`MAT.tint`); per-sub-tile instances are culled through
  `cullGeo` wrappers; shared geometries live in `SHARED`.

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
